alex: Heads up — noticed p95 latency jump (~12% -> 28%) on mixtral-moerouter after rolling quantized matmul kernel (v2.3.1) yesterday. Only affects long-context (>=2k) requests with KV cache enabled.

mira: timeline? which deploy/commit?

alex: rolled at 2026-03-18T17:10Z, commit c3f8b2, kernel: matmul_q8 -> matmul_q8_fuse_v2.3.1

alex: quick numbers: before canary p95=120ms p99=240ms; after canary p95=135ms p99=315ms. throughput -7% at steady 1-concurrency baseline.

julian: can you paste the profiler snippet and kernel selection trace?

alex: pasted profiler:
```
GPU0: kernel matmul_q8_fuse_v2.3.1
seq_len=2048, batch=1, kv_cache_hit_rate=0.78
ROPE scale applied (dynamic) due to head_dim mismatch
router_topk=2
p95 135ms, p99 315ms
alloc stall ~2.1ms/slice
```

mira: hmm — RoPE scaling + fused quant kernel could be introducing extra memory ops. Did we change head_dim or kv dims recently?

alex: yes: model config tweak to improve packing: head_dim 64 -> 56. This was intended to reduce quant padding but apparently changed RoPE frequency table generation so we rescale at runtime.

lena: runtime rescale probably does an extra gather+mul per token. That could trigger an unfused code path. Any kernel fallbacks in the trace?

alex: trace shows selection histogram: matmul_q8_fuse preferred but ~6% tokens hit fallback_matmul_fp16 path when the RoPE/rescale produced an unaligned tensor shape.

julian: fallback explains the p99 tail. Why fallback for head_dim=56? 56%8==0 so alignment seems fine. Is kv_dim alignment different because num_experts or router sharding multiplies heads?

mira: good call — kv_dim = head_dim * num_heads = 56 * 64 = 3584; our fused kernel expects kv_dim % 256 == 0 on this architecture for vectorized stores. 3584 % 256 == 0? 3584 / 256 = 14 so it is divisible. Strange.

alex: I ran a microbench locally:
```
./bench --model mixtral_moe --kernel matmul_q8_fuse --head_dim 56 --num_heads 64 --seq 2048
Result: avg 132ms, 6% fallback to fp16 path, p95 jitter.
```

ci-bot: @alex created perf ticket INF-422 with attached flamegraphs and kernel traces.

lena: short-term mitigation ideas:
- set router_topk=1 on the canary path to reduce router op count (fewer expert scatters)
- force matmul_q8 (non-fused) for mixtral-moex route on canary (safer path)

mira: also consider tuning expert_parallelism (current=2) -> try 4 to spread per-expert memory working set, but watch total memory.

julian: caveat: raising parallelism increases total memory usage linearly; combined with KV cache at 78% hit, we could blow OOM for large sequences. We need mem profiles.

alex: experiment plan (canary + bench):
- rollback fused kernel to matmul_q8 on 5% traffic canary
- run head_dim=64 variant (no packing) micro-canary to see if rescale goes away
- sweep router_topk in {1,2,3} and expert_parallelism in {2,4} and measure p95/p99, throughput, and fallback %
- instrument RoPE rescale counters and kernel selection histogram

mira: please add a quick metric: rescale_calls_per_token and rescale_time_ms_total so we can correlate.

alex: added counters to bench harness. initial kernel selection histogram (sample):
```
KernelSelectionHistogram:
matmul_q8_fuse: 92%
matmul_q8: 1.5%
fallback_fp16: 6.5%
```

lena: that 1.5% matmul_q8 indicates existence of alternative path — fusion dispatch is non-deterministic depending on slice shape. I'm going to add a runtime guard to skip fused kernel for mixtral-moex until we root cause.

julian: long-term fixes: support unaligned head dims in fused kernel, or add a fast RoPE-rescale kernel fused into quant matmul so we avoid reshuffle+fallback. Both will reduce tail.

alex: scheduling: I'll rollback the kernel on canary at 18:30 UTC and start the sweep. Anyone want to join the perf run at 10:30 PST?
mira: I'll join.
julian: count me in.
perf-bot: scheduled bench job bench-mixtral-1870123456 at 2026-03-18T18:30:00Z

alex: updating INF-422 with canary numbers after the run. Thanks all for quick triage :thumbsup:
